tail: If the already-retained evidence has an important limitation for this analysis, document it clearly. In particular, do not imply exact intermediate filesystem reconstruction where Campaign 002 lacks a complete mutation journal. The final workspace and evidenced intermediate versions are still useful and should be preserved as such.

When the ten-run behavioral evidence package is complete and independently checked, stop for review. Do not start the task-expansion experiment, change Robot-Codex's writing style, modify the filesystem framework, or launch a new scientific campaign. I want ChatGPT and me to examine the natural behavior first.

The [ten-run behavioral evidence package](../../../Long-Horizon%20Adaptive%20Robotics%20Expirement/Robot-Codex%20Integration%20001/campaign-002/investigation/behavioral-evidence/README.md) is complete and ready for ChatGPT and your review. Exact intermediate filesystem states and mutation times remain unknown without a journal. Final snapshots are untimed; hash-only contents, requested-only mutations, omitted metadata and one ambiguous cat/find boundary stay explicit. Exact endpoint draft reads include rejected Continuity publication. Background observations do not imply an agent read. Public notes/messages remain the agent's own claims. Hidden reasoning, credentials, raw private envelopes and unrelated protected internals are excluded.

No Robot-Codex/Astra simulation/model run, scored retry, writing-style change, filesystem-framework change, UAC, spending, physical action or subagent occurred. Campaign 002 and Campaign 001 remain immutable. I am stopping at the requested review boundary; task expansion remains deferred.
